DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Thrombocythemia.

The combination of thrombocytosis (platelets 700,000), dysplastic megakaryocytes on the smear, and the specific JAK2-associated genetic mutation on chromosome 9 (typically JAK2 V617F) confirms this myeloproliferative neoplasm. The fatigue and concentration issues are likely secondary to the underlying marrow disorder or potential microvascular disturbances.
